author: SlidePoise contributors (henryhyw/slidepoise)
method: Original prepare_generation compiled exact bound requests → builtin image_gen → original normalize_generation_canvas → host-authored semantic map → original OpenCV measurement → original reconstruction contract → original constructor scene → original slidepoise_runtime render-deck / scene_to_pptx renderer and native postprocess.
native_scope: Native Japanese/Latin text, rectangles/roundRect/ellipses, editable freeform chevrons and diamond, native connectors; no full-slide screenshot image objects.

modifications: Local runtime text_fit.py only: map requested Dela/BIZ/Manrope families to the bundled original OSS TTF metrics on Windows rather than falling back to Arial.
Reconstruction config explicitly uses agent_observed font-family policy so Manrope is preserved; original generation config/request remain unchanged.
Headline target-size/weight adjusted in semantic map after the first PowerPoint display wrapped the Japanese final period. The second native render shows the full sentence.
Local export_case.ps1 omits Application.Quit and closes only its openedDeck.
Three substantive pages replace the initial six-page proposal so the original image/OpenCV/constructor path is fully exercised.
Scoped source acquisition excludes media/examples/library-set assets; each pinned source blob matches the audited Git tree.
visual_limitations: Native font shaping and flat fills differ from generated text ink and paper shading; pixel-perfect fidelity is not claimed.
Third final page was generated/opened/exported but not detailed visually reviewed.
